description: Recent buys, one short row each: order id, time, status, charged sats, refunded sats, and net sats. Charged is the gross debit. Net is charged minus refunded. Pass include_results for each stored result, or get_order for one order's notes and delivery. Pass cursor from nextCursor to read the next page. Read-only.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit it for the newest orders.

include_results.description: Default false. Set true to include each stored result. Leave it unset for the short summary.

limit.description: How many orders to return. Default 20, maximum 50. (minimum 1).

name: orders

outputSchema.description: The same object as the text JSON. code is set when the call stopped before delivery.

approvalUrl.description: Page where the person approves this exact price.

results.description: Search rows when this is a search result.

which.description: per_call, per_day, per_session, per_hour_buys, per_minute_calls, or per_minute_sats.

title: Orders
